title: Dekisugi-kun — Learn by teaching
capture: Current native Android app on a dedicated emulator. Edited for pace; no fabricated UI or seeded progress.

scenes.title:
Same height.
Different weights.
scenes.body:
Which ball lands first
in a vacuum?
narration: Two balls. Same height. Different weights. Which lands first in a vacuum?

scenes.title:
Meet your
study companion.
scenes.body:
Read the evidence.
Explain it in your own words.
Help Dekisugi-kun rethink.
narration: Meet Dekisugi-kun, a science companion you teach.
You read the evidence, then explain the idea in your own words.

scenes.title:
Start with
your own idea.
scenes.body:
Make a prediction
before seeing the material.
narration: Here, I think the heavier ball will fall faster. Let's check the evidence.

scenes.title:
Look for why.
Look for when.
scenes.body:
The explanation matters.
So do its conditions.
narration: The lesson explains both the principle and the conditions under which it holds.
The next step is to teach it back.

scenes.title:
Close the material.
Teach it back.
scenes.body:
The source is hidden.
Explain by text or voice.
narration: I explain that the balls fall together when air resistance is negligible.
Typing is a full learning route, alongside voice.

scenes.title:
An explanation
starts a conversation.
scenes.body:
Review the key terms.
Answer a follow-up.
Try a clearer explanation.
narration: The app shows key-term coverage, then asks a fixed follow-up question.
A wrong choice brings a hint and another try, so I can rethink the missing condition.

scenes.title:
Keep track of
what needs another look.
scenes.body:
Keep a record.
Revisit uncertain ideas.
Explain them again.
narration: The record shows which of the companion's misconceptions were corrected, and which are still unsure.
The goal is a clearer explanation.

scenes.title:
Support the app.
Keep learning free.
scenes.body:
Optional companion styling
and parent reports.
Core lessons stay available.
scenes.tag: RevenueCat Test Store · No real charge
narration: Optional Plus adds companion styling and parent reports.
This is a RevenueCat Test Store purchase, with no real charge. The core lessons stay available.

scenes.title:
Read it.
Explain it.
Rethink it.
scenes.tag: On-device learning demo · External generative AI disabled
narration: Read it. Explain it. Rethink it.
